channel.title: Houston Public Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Houston Public Media (houstonpublicmedia.org)

item.title: Four Aldine ISD students hospitalized after alleged teenage car thief crashes into school bus, authorities say
item.description: The Harris County Sheriff’s Office says it arrested a 17-year-old boy who is accused of crashing a stolen car into a school bus with 27 students.

item.title: Hello Houston (January 28, 2026)
item.description: Today: We discuss a new study on Houston’s Asian American population, talk with actor Zachary Keller about the hit Broadway musical “Water for Elephants,” and learn about MFAH’s new Frida Kahlo exhibition.

item.title: How NASA is considering weather for Artemis II mission, 40 years after Challenger disaster
item.description: Cold temperatures inhibited the space shuttle Challenger’s infrastructure from working properly. NASA has set potential weather conditions that would stop Artemis II from launching as scheduled.

item.title: At least 9 dead in Texas as winter storm grips state
item.description: A majority of the victims in Texas were children. Nationally, the storm has reportedly killed at least 50 people.

item.title: Local victims identified in Maine plane crash tied to Houston law firm
item.description: A founding partner of the Arnold & Itkin law firm is listed as the agent for the company that owns the plane.

item.title: Hello Houston – The Commuter Cut (January 28, 2026)
item.description: For our busy Houston commuters – we have “The Commuter Cut” – a special 40-minute version of our show to listen to during your journey home.

item.title: City of Houston appeals $13 million jury award to family of man killed in HPD crash
item.description: The lawyers representing Payne’s family did not immediately respond to a request for comment regarding the city’s appeal, but said via a previous statement that the jury made the right decision.

item.title: What to know about Arnold & Itkin, the Houston law firm linked to the Maine plane crash
item.description: The business jet that crashed at Bangor International Airport on Sunday evening is registered to a company at the same address as Arnold & Itkin, a personal injury firm that has won multiple billion-dollar verdicts.

item.title: DPS troopers clash with protesters outside South Texas ICE detention facility
item.description: Texas Department of Public Safety troopers used a chemical irritant against demonstrators, who were protested the detention of a five-year-old boy.

item.title: Houston City Council members discuss chaotic public comment period with anti-ICE speakers
item.description: Mayor John Whitmire limited speakers to one minute each because so many people had signed up. Some weren't present when their names were called, and they were unable to speak.
